classification.illumination_detail: internal LED cabinet + external up/down sconce + full-color EMC

knowledge.plain_language_summary: Option 1: a single-sided monument with a push-through ID cabinet, a 12mm full-color EMC, a decorative faux-building timber/shingle column with an oil-rubbed-bronze up/down sconce, on a cultured-stone-veneer CMU base. Reuses an existing pole.
knowledge.rationale: A faux-building column ties the monument to the center's architecture; the large EMC carries dynamic messaging; reusing the existing pole/footing cuts cost.

structure.construction: fabricated aluminum, angle frame, 0.090in skin painted satin; push-thru 3/4in clear acrylic, white diffuser 2nd-surface, translucent red/blue vinyl 1st-surface; white LED
12mm full-color EMC, 36x48in, wireless, mounted to ID cabinet
wood frame, plywood sheathing, wood trim + shingles to match buildings, crown cap; oil-rubbed bronze up/down sconce wired to sign power; bolted non-structural
non-structural CMU on poured concrete footing, dry-stacked cultured stone veneer; saddle-mounted to two 4in steel poles (one existing + one new Sch40)

craft_observations: Faux-building column mimics center architecture; large landscape EMC; reuses existing pole.
